irene: Quick PR ready (#5250). Adds a small section on defensive parsing patterns for function/tool outputs, plus compact JS+Python examples. Want a quick sanity check on wording + links.

otto: Nice. Can you include a tiny streaming assembly example that tolerates stray commas and extra keys? Many users hit that.

irene: Added this JS snippet using our helper:```js
let buf = ''
for await (const chunk of resp.stream()) {
  buf += chunk
  try {
    return parse_structured(buf) // tolerant helper
  } catch (err) { continue }
}
```

liam: Suggest a short note warning against aggressive regex fixes; include an example heuristic for trailing commas with a clear "last-resort" label.

irene: Done. I added a one-line sanitize example and flagged it as heuristic. Also added a tiny pytest in tests/docs/test_parse_fallbacks.py to prevent regressions.
